race.comment: PONZI SCHEME (5) has the most appealing upward profile, with his Moruya third over 1200m a clear move forward after he began slowly and was never a factor first-up at Kembla Grange. He is fitter third-up, has already placed at this distance and looks ready to press harder. CAPDIVA (3) has stronger depth than her latest sixth suggests, having raced wide without cover at Newcastle after a close second the run before. Brings solid recent ratings. NICOLOSI (4) resumed with a second at this track after being checked at the start, so that run has enough merit to make her a genuine threat with natural improvement. DIAMOND DICE (7) has placed in three of four starts, was held up near the 200m when beaten a length at Bathurst, and her 1200m record keeps her in the winning mix.
